title: Connect the existing sealed final artifact return caller
summary: Connected the existing sealed final artifact return caller, verified explicit candidate compose resolution without ambient PWD dependency, wired candidate receipt and final FE seal validation into compensation evidence and deployment workflows, enforced all eight identity fields on retained typed readback seals, resolved strict auth preflight isolation during artifact operations, and provided connected positive CLI proof.

ac1_correct_final_caller_gaps.evidence: Fixed runner compensation validator rejection of final readback (both as restore and restore-final). Added restore-final operation support and validated candidate receipt and FE seal digests in dev_artifact_compensation_evidence.py.

ac2_driver_verify_and_restore_final.evidence: Extended deploy_nonprod_vm.sh with --artifact-target <baseline|final>, --artifact-restore-final, explicit candidate compose resolution via resolve_dev_candidate_compose, and candidate argument forwarding. Connected nonprod-deploy.yml coordinate-dev-release to run final verify/seal readback under a pinned per-operation lease and lease wrapper on frontend_release success before accepting the release.

ac3_extend_compensation_evidence.evidence: dev_artifact_compensation_evidence.py validates admitted final readback against candidate receipt and candidate-frontend.json seal (deliberately consuming validated frontend structure from typed readbacks or seal files, and strictly verifying all eight identity fields: candidate_id, run_id, attempt, controller_sha, candidate_backend_sha, candidate_frontend_sha, previous_backend_sha, previous_frontend_sha with exact keys), verifies candidate backend SHA, and sets restored_pair to candidate on restore-final while preserving baseline restore.

ac4_supported_invocations_documented.evidence: Documented concrete CLI invocations for final verify and restore-final in docs/deployment/dev-exact-artifact-rollback.md without modifying FE controller or symlinks directly, including credential preflight isolation and connected CLI verification.

ac5_full_test_suite_coverage.evidence: Added connected positive control test (test_full_cli_restore_final_connected_positive) covering full CLI -> isolated transport -> remote driver -> real FE owner with 5-field seals -> real compensation evidence validator, plus hostile ambient working directory, tampered seals across all 8 identity fields, structural typed readback negatives, mixed baseline/candidate identities, missing receipts, typed readback seal consumption, and workflow lease contracts across test_deploy_nonprod_bff_strict_auth_default_contract.py, test_cross_repo_release_controller.py, test_dev_artifact_compensation_evidence.py, test_deploy_nonprod_artifact_restore.py, and test_nonprod_dev_artifact_workflow.py (410 passed, 0 failed, 0 skipped).

ac6_scoped_files_only.evidence: Only the 9 scoped files modified and tracked. Non-interactive worker commit and task handoff.

counter_resolution.item1_initial_final_verify_fe_digests: deploy_nonprod_vm.sh permits initial final verify without FE digests while restore-final remains strict.
counter_resolution.item2_connected_operation_proof: dev_artifact_compensation_evidence.py allows distinct original run_id/attempt from current workflow, reporting current run while enforcing 8-field equality with candidate receipt.
counter_resolution.item3_explicit_candidate_compose: candidate compose path is explicitly resolved from candidate context/receipt without search lists or ambient PWD fallback.
counter_resolution.item4_workflow_reusal: nonprod-deploy.yml final_artifact_verify reuses compensate_cross_repo_release.sh without duplicate lease lifecycle.
counter_resolution.item5_controller_log_and_outcome: compensate_cross_repo_release.sh and dev_artifact_compensation_evidence.py accept absent failure_log on success and return outcome restore-final.
counter_resolution.item6_real_fe_owner_delegation: deploy_nonprod_vm.sh forwards exact FE owner parameters (pantheon-dev-deploy, epoch, run_id, event_name, roots), switches legs using original 5-field seals, and safely skips redundant switch if live matches target.
counter_resolution.item7_compensation_error_handling: nonprod-deploy.yml always() includes final verify failure for preparation and compensation.
counter_resolution.item8_strict_auth_preflight_isolation: deploy_nonprod_vm.sh isolates deploy-only actor credential preflight so artifact verify/restore operations do not fail without write-capable secrets, while remote driver retains strict non-stub auth defaults.
counter_resolution.item9_connected_cli_proof: test_full_cli_restore_final_connected_positive tests full CLI invocation through isolated transport, remote driver, real FE deploy script with full 5-field seals, and real dev_artifact_compensation_evidence.py readback validation.
